svg.title: Brane AIF — the AI Interaction Firewall
svg.desc: As CTO I own the architecture of Brane AIF, an on-prem firewall between a company and every AI model. Every prompt is inspected, classified by intent, checked against policy and routed, in under 200 ms. Sensitive data goes to a private model and never leaves; the rest reaches cloud models anonymised and is rehydrated in the answer.
